$comment: What this repository may contain at its top levels, and which large, data or force-added files are there on purpose. Checked on every pull request by .github/workflows/repo-layout.yml; locally `b1 check-layout`. Add an entry, with what it is for, when a new folder or file really belongs here. Rules: node_modules/@buildone/swat-cli/knowledge/architecture_info/repository-layout.md.

root..agents: Codex skills (the b1- skills are synced in by the CLI)
root..b1: Build.One's internal folder (the migrations ledger; everything else stays local)
root..build: Deployment configuration layers (until the stack is rendered from repository objects)
root..vscode: Shared VS Code settings and tasks

src.data: Blueprint export: the app's repository objects, versioned in git

largeFiles..yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs: The pinned Yarn release; Yarn runs it from the repository

unlimitedFiles.yarn.lock: Dependency lockfile; it grows with the dependencies, so it has no size limit
